sections.title: Pieces of Heart
sections.note: 45 pieces; every five make a heart. Tags give the items you need.

items.name: Faron Woods cave
items.area: Cave in the north-east of Faron Woods (where the Small Key is)
items.howTo: In the cave at the north-east of Faron Woods, light the two torches at the dead end with the Lantern to make a chest appear. Get it on your first visit, or later by waving the Lantern to push through the purple fog.

items.name: Forest Temple: Deku Like alcove
items.area: Room with the Bomblings and Deku Likes, north-west of the entrance
items.howTo: A big Deku Like blocks an alcove with a chest. Drop a Bombling into its mouth from the platform above (or use a Bomb later) to clear the way.
items.notes: Once the temple is cleared and the monkeys are gone, come back with the Clawshot to reach this room.

items.name: Forest Temple: Tile Worm room
items.area: Far west room with the Tile Worms and four torches
items.howTo: Blow out all the torches with the Gale Boomerang to lower the wooden platforms, then climb to the chest in the alcove.
items.notes: After the temple, use the Clawshot on the vines to get back here.

items.name: Tree by the Faron Field bridge
items.area: Hyrule Field (Faron), south end of the central bridge
items.howTo: Go north from Faron Woods to the rise just south of the bridge (two Bulblins guard it). The piece is in the branches of the tree there: grab it with the Gale Boomerang.

items.name: Kakariko Gorge rock spire
items.area: Kakariko Gorge, the tall rock formation out over the gorge
items.howTo: South of Kakariko Village, look out over the gorge for the taller of two rock spires. The piece spins on top of it: lock on and fetch it with the Gale Boomerang.

items.name: Goat herding for Fado
items.area: Ordon Ranch
items.howTo: Back in Ordon by day, talk to Fado at the ranch and offer to herd the goats on Epona. Herd all 20 into the barn in under 3 minutes (the record he sets).

items.name: Goron Mines: magnetic ceiling
items.area: The big room where you walk on the ceiling
items.howTo: In the room where the Iron Boots let you walk on the magnetic ceiling, walk to the far north-east corner to find a hidden platform with a chest.

items.name: Goron Mines: Beamos room
items.area: Second-floor room with two Beamos and a drawbridge, north of the main chamber
items.howTo: Walk up the magnetic track on the west wall with the Iron Boots and follow its southern branch to a ledge with a chest.

items.name: Talo's archery lesson
items.area: Kakariko Village, the lookout tower
items.howTo: By day, get a Goron to boost you onto the roofs and climb to Talo at the top of the lookout. Show him how to use the bow: after two easy targets, hit the pole on the corner of the high building without the Hawkeye. Malo hands over the piece.

items.name: Rocks above Eldin Spring
items.area: Kakariko Village, the cliff above Eldin Spring
items.howTo: Shoot a Bomb Arrow at the three rocks on the cliff top above the spring to uncover the piece, then pull it down with the Gale Boomerang.

items.name: Under the Eldin Spring pool
items.area: Kakariko Village, the cave behind the boulder east of Eldin Spring
items.howTo: Bomb the big boulder east of Eldin Spring and follow the path into the pool. Sink with the Iron Boots and open the chest on the bottom, then surface quickly.

items.name: Death Mountain ledge cave
items.area: Death Mountain Trail
items.howTo: Ask the second Goron on the trail for a boost, but aim west and grab the ledge. Follow that upper path north and drop into the cave on the west side for the chest.

items.name: Kakariko Gorge lantern cavern
items.area: Cave south-east of the Kakariko Gorge bridge
items.howTo: Bomb the boulder south-east of the gorge bridge and go in with a full Lantern. At the forks go right, right, left, right; kill the Skulltula at the dead end and light the two torches for the chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon's route (GameCube and HD Normal); it is mirrored on Wii and in Hero Mode.

items.name: Vine ledge north of Kakariko
items.area: Hyrule Field (Eldin), rocky area just north of Kakariko Village
items.howTo: Leave Kakariko to the north and bomb the boulder on the east side at the end of the wall. Follow the path, Bomb-Arrow the rocks above the vines across the gap, jump to the vines and climb up to the chest on the ledge.

items.name: Charlo's donation box
items.area: Castle Town, West Road (by Purlo's tent)
items.howTo: Talk to Charlo, the man in the green robe, and donate in 30, 50 or 100 Rupee lots. Once he has had 1,000 Rupees in all he gives you the piece.
items.notes: Agitha's Golden Bug rewards are a quick way to raise the Rupees. HD: the bigger HD wallets make this easier.

items.name: Hena's Fishing Hole rock
items.area: Hena's Fishing Hole, Upper Zora's River
items.howTo: Rent Hena's canoe, paddle out to the rock arch in the middle of the pond and hook the piece on top of it with the Fishing Rod (or lock on from the shore with the Gale Boomerang or Clawshot).

items.name: Flight-by-Fowl: Isle of Riches
items.area: Lake Hylia, Isle of Riches
items.howTo: Get Fyer to fire you up to Falbi's Flight-by-Fowl (20 Rupees). Glide a Cucco to the floating Isle of Riches: the chest is on the highest tier that doesn't spin, just under the rotating top.

items.name: Lake Hylia lantern cavern
items.area: Cave in the south of Lake Hylia, up the ladder
items.howTo: Climb the ladder in the south of the lake and bomb the boulder to open a long, dark cavern. Work through it with a full Lantern and Bombs; light the two torches in the last chamber for the chest.

items.name: Lakebed Temple: chandelier
items.area: Central chamber with the spinning staircase
items.howTo: With the Clawshot, grapple from target to target up to the giant chandelier in the middle of the ceiling. The chest is on top.

items.name: Lakebed Temple: east bridge room
items.area: Lower east room with rotating platforms and stalactites
items.howTo: Turn the staircase so water flows east and floods the room: the bridge rises. Cross it south, stand on the switch and Clawshot to the far side before the gate shuts.

items.name: Sacred Grove grotto
items.area: Sacred Grove, the clearing where you first fight Skull Kid
items.howTo: Bomb the boulder by the pillar in the middle of the clearing, then dig at the glowing spot as a wolf. Kill every Baba Serpent below (the hanging ones fall to the Gale Boomerang) to make the chest appear.

items.name: Goron Springwater Rush
items.area: From Kakariko's Malo Mart to the Goron at Castle Town's east bridge
items.howTo: Talk to the Goron elder outside Kakariko's Malo Mart and carry a barrel of hot spring water across the field without dropping it or letting it cool. Throw it on the Goron at Castle Town's east gate.
items.after: After paying 1,000 Rupees at Kakariko's Malo Mart to rebuild the east bridge
items.notes: It also opens the Malo Mart in Castle Town.

items.name: Lanayru Spring back room
items.area: Lanayru Spring, Lake Hylia
items.howTo: Inside the spring, Clawshot to the vines on either side and follow the ledge to a hidden room at the back. Light the two torches for the chest.

items.name: Plumm's Fruit Pop
items.area: Lake Hylia, by Hawk Grass
items.howTo: As a wolf, howl at the Hawk Grass on the east side of the lake (by the bridge to Falbi's house, or on the strip of land further south) to meet Plumm, and ride the Kargarok popping fruit balloons. Score 10,000 points: chaining one fruit type, oranges or strawberries, gets there.

items.name: Bridge of Eldin magnet cavern
items.area: Cave up the east cliff, north of the Bridge of Eldin
items.howTo: Clawshot to the ledge on the cliff north of the bridge, go south and east into the cavern. Drop down and stick to the magnetic walls with the Iron Boots; the chest is at the very bottom.
items.after: After the Bridge of Eldin is restored (from Gerudo Desert)

items.name: Bulblin Camp roast
items.area: Bulblin Camp, north-east corner
items.howTo: In the north-east corner of the Bulblin Camp a boar is roasting on a spit. Slash it (a Spin Attack clears the embers) until it bursts and drops the piece.

items.name: Arbiter's Grounds: central chamber
items.area: North-east corner of the central chamber (where the Poes steal the flames)
items.howTo: Clawshot over the sinking sand to the chest beside the stairs, then roll back along the platforms rather than walk through the sand.

items.name: Arbiter's Grounds: Spinner rails
items.area: Basement room with Spinner rails on several levels (north-west)
items.howTo: Ride the wall rails with the Spinner to the middle level and on to the east side's upper platform. Beat the Stalfos guarding the chest.

items.name: Spinner rails north of the Great Bridge
items.area: Back road between the Great Bridge of Hylia and the field north of Castle Town
items.howTo: Bomb the boulders blocking the back road, then ride the rail at the foot of the wall with the Spinner and jump between the zigzag rails up to the hilltop chest.

items.name: Stalfos grotto north of the Bridge of Eldin
items.area: Small bridge over the gulch, by the Hidden Village path
items.howTo: Ride the Spinner rail on the north wall by the small bridge down to a grassy ledge and dig in the middle as a wolf. Kill the three Stalfos below (finish them with Bombs) to make the chest appear.
items.after: After the Bridge of Eldin is restored

items.name: Snowpeak Ruins: cracked floor
items.area: Second floor, south-west room with caged Freezards and a cannon
items.howTo: Break the cracked floor in the corner with Bombs or the Ball and Chain and drop into a hidden first-floor room with the chest. A Clawshot target takes you back up.

items.name: Snowpeak Ruins: chandeliers
items.area: Second floor of the entrance hall
items.howTo: Hit the north chandelier with the Ball and Chain to swing it, hop on, and keep hitting and jumping to the next two to reach the chest on the south ledge.

items.name: Ice block puzzle cave
items.area: Hyrule Field north of Castle Town, rocky area to the far north
items.howTo: Blow open the cave (east-facing, by a Tektite and Lizalfos), smash the ice with the Ball and Chain and solve three rooms of sliding block puzzles. The chest is in the last room.

items.name: Snowboard race with Yeta
items.area: Snowpeak Top, the slope down to the ruins
items.howTo: Warp to Snowpeak Top and beat Yeto in a snowboard race, then race Yeta. She takes a shortcut jump halfway down (shown on the map): take it too and beat her for the piece.

items.name: Temple of Time: electric barrier
items.area: Room with sliding walls and Lizalfos/Dynalfos
items.howTo: On the way back down with the statue, guide the giant statue or a small one onto the switch behind the electric barrier to switch it off, then open the chest in the corner.

items.name: Temple of Time: south room switches
items.area: Fifth floor, far south room
items.howTo: Clear the room, then with the Dominion Rod walk the small statue on the upper platform down onto one floor switch and another statue onto the other. A chest appears in the east alcove.

items.name: Hidden Village cats
items.area: Hidden Village
items.howTo: As a wolf, find the Cucco leader behind the glass in the large east building and agree to talk to all 20 cats around the village (some need the Clawshot or crashing through a window). Pick up the piece in front of Impaz's house.
items.notes: Don't go into Impaz's house before you finish, or the count starts again.

items.name: Temple of Time: owl statue
items.area: Entrance hall, south-east corner
items.howTo: Move the Owl Statue in the south-east corner of the temple's entrance hall (left at the foot of the stairs) with the Dominion Rod to open a passage to the chest.
items.after: Once the Dominion Rod's power is restored

items.name: Bridge of Eldin owl statue
items.area: Bridge of Eldin
items.howTo: Pull the Owl Statue down from its ledge at the north end of the bridge, walk it to the south end and drop it into the low area to the west. Use it as a step to jump to the ladder, then beat the Bulblin Archer on the wall for the chest.
items.after: Once the Dominion Rod's power is restored

items.name: Faron Woods owl statue
items.area: South Faron Woods, north of Coro's hut
items.howTo: Move the Owl Statue (the Sky Character one) into the round hole on the far side of the tree. As a wolf, stand on the nearby rock and use Midna's jumps to climb to the hidden chest above the woods.
items.after: Once the Dominion Rod's power is restored
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon calls the spot Ordon Woods; StrategyWiki and Zelda's Palace put it in Faron Woods.

items.name: City in the Sky: Big Baba room
items.area: West wing, the cylinder room with the Big Baba
items.howTo: After the Big Baba, Clawshot up to the second floor of the room and go round to the far side. Shoot the Keese in the alcove, grab the ledge and shimmy across to drop onto the chest.

items.name: City in the Sky: Peahat balcony
items.area: West wing, third floor, outdoor room full of Peahats
items.howTo: Leave by the north-east exit and Clawshot from Peahat to Peahat along the 'V' to the southern balcony with the chest.

items.name: Kakariko Gorge Clawshot pillar
items.area: Kakariko Gorge, rock formation out in the gorge
items.howTo: Clawshot the target on the rock formation out in the gorge, then the cliff wall, then the vines on the small formation. Climb round the vines to the ledge with the chest.
items.notes: StrategyWiki says the pillar is in the gorge's south-east, Zelda Dungeon its far west. Careful positioning gets it with a single Clawshot.

items.name: Palace of Twilight: behind the fog
items.area: Wing with four falls of black fog
items.howTo: Clear the fog fall that hides an alcove (marked on the map) by carrying a Sol near it or with the light-filled Master Sword, then Clawshot up to the chest.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon puts this in the east wing, StrategyWiki in the west (GameCube); there is one piece in each wing.

items.name: Palace of Twilight: dark orb platform
items.area: First room of the other wing
items.howTo: Light the dark orb at the north of the lower level with a Sol (or the light-filled Master Sword). Two platforms start moving: ride the one to the alcove with the chest.

sections.title: Heart Containers
sections.note: One from each boss but Ganondorf.

items.name: Diababa
items.area: Forest Temple
items.howTo: Defeat Diababa, the Forest Temple's boss, and take the Heart Container it leaves.

items.name: Fyrus
items.area: Goron Mines
items.howTo: Defeat Fyrus, the Goron Mines' boss, and take the Heart Container it leaves.

items.name: Morpheel
items.area: Lakebed Temple
items.howTo: Defeat Morpheel, the Lakebed Temple's boss, and take the Heart Container it leaves.

items.name: Stallord
items.area: Arbiter's Grounds
items.howTo: Defeat Stallord, the Arbiter's Grounds' boss, and take the Heart Container it leaves.

items.name: Blizzeta
items.area: Snowpeak Ruins
items.howTo: Defeat Blizzeta, the Snowpeak Ruins' boss. The Heart Container appears when Yeto and Yeta embrace afterwards.

items.name: Armogohma
items.area: Temple of Time
items.howTo: Defeat Armogohma, the Temple of Time's boss, and take the Heart Container it leaves.

items.name: Argorok
items.area: City in the Sky
items.howTo: Defeat Argorok, the City in the Sky's boss, and take the Heart Container it leaves.

items.name: Zant
items.area: Palace of Twilight
items.howTo: Defeat Zant, the Palace of Twilight's boss, and take the Heart Container he leaves.
items.notes: The last container: Ganondorf, in Hyrule Castle, leaves none.
